findings.summary: ledgerVerdictsAt reads the reviews ledger with git show <headRef>:<ledger>, so a round only counts as corroborated once its ledger records are committed. In the step 7/9 headless path, if records are not committed before the next round every later round falls to review-uncorroborated and runs full (safe, but defeats the feature). Check the delta share report on real rounds.

findings.summary: The delta/skip decision trusts ledger records on the task branch that the developer agent can write via Bash redirects; the new blockedPaths entries are enforced only for Write/Edit/MultiEdit, so the gates.yaml claim that the agent under review cannot rewrite the ledger is overstated. Impact limited (forged line shows in the PR diff; a rejecting reviewer still gets a full review unless also forged). Suggested: check base-commit approval against signed transcript leaves or the prior DSSE envelope, or reword the gates.yaml property to Write/Edit only.
